# GeneSight

> GeneSight is a pharmacogenomic DNA testing platform that helps patients and clinicians optimize psychiatric medication selection based on individual genetic profiles.

GeneSight offers genetic testing for psychiatric medications and provides comprehensive resources for both patients and healthcare providers. The platform includes at-home testing kits, insurance coverage information, clinical research, and educational materials to support informed mental health treatment decisions.

## Key Topics
